subject: New Line token in facet titles

messages.author: 519455d3bf64680d
messages.subject: New Line token in facet titles
parts:
I am trying to get a new line into a facet strip title.

ggplot works fine:

A<- c("test", "test 2")
B<- c(1, 2)
C<- c(4,8)
test<-data.frame(A,B,C)
str(test)
ggplot(data=test)+geom_point(aes(x=B, y=C))+facet_grid(.~A)

The problem is that I am using a csv file as my data source. I have
placed the in the title field within the csv file, e.g. "This Title",
but once the file is read into R (using readtable), the variable is rendered as
"This\nTitle" in the data frame. The additional \ foils the plan for a two-line facet
title. Suggestions?

Thanks,

Rob

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: New Line token in facet titles
parts:
Hi, you can use sub family to replace \\n with \n:

title <- 'hello\\ntitle'
print(title)
qplot(1,1,main=sub("\\\\n","\n",title))
